pheggu.cp: neut. wood surrounding the pith of a tree; a worthless thing.
pheggu.p: [Phala+gu] (thī,na) Google Translate Flanate ဂု၊ Latsa Go. အ သေ. ဖေ ဂု. ဖ +⁇ င ် ဇ + ဏု. . . Zatsagwe Dwe Bhavanu. သူ စိ. 372.] (1) Tha Aung; Kha Aung. (2) Protection.
a: ဖေဂ္ဂု(ထီ၊န)
ဖလ နိပ္ဖတ္တိယံ၊ ဂု၊ လဿ ဂေါ။ အဿေ။ ဖေဂ္ဂု။ ဖ+ဣဉ္ဇ+ဏု။ ဖေန ဝါတေန ဣဉ္ဇတီတိ ဝါ ဖေဂ္ဂု၊ ဖသဒ္ဒူပပဒဣဉ္ဇ ကမ္ပနေ။ ဇဿ ဂေါ ဒွေဘာဝေါ ဏု။ သူစိ။ ၃၇၂။] (၁)ထအောင်း၊ ခအောင်း။(၂)အကာ။

B:
pheggu： pheggu（thī，na）
ဖေဂ္ဂု（ထီ၊န）
[phala+gu．phala nipphattiyaṃ，gu，lassa go．asse．pheggu．pha+iñja+ṇu．phena vātena iñjatīti vā pheggu，phasaddūpapadaiñja kampane．jassa go dvebhāvo ṇu．sūci．372．]
[ဖလ+ဂု။ ဖလ နိပ္ဖတ္တိယံ၊ ဂု၊ လဿ ဂေါ။ အေဿ။ ဖေဂ္ဂု။ ဖ+ဣဉ္ဇ+ဏု။ ဖေန ဝါတေန ဣဉ္ဇတီတိ ဝါ ဖေဂ္ဂု၊ ဖသဒ္ဒူပပဒဣဉ္ဇ ကမ္ပနေ။ ဇဿ ဂေါ ဒွေဘာဝေါ ဏု။ သူစိ။ ၃၇၂။]
C: pheggu：[nt．] wood surrounding the pith of a tree； a worthless thing．
P: Pheggu，[cp．Vedic phalgu & P．phaggu in form] accessory wood，wood surrounding the pith of a tree，always with ref．to trees （freq．in similes），in sequence mūla，sāra，pheggu，taca，papaṭikā etc．It is represented as next to the pith，but inferior and worthless．At all passages contrasted with sāra （pith，substance）．Thus at M．I，192 sq．，488； D．III，51； S．IV，168； A．I，152 （pheggu+ sāra，v．l．phaggu）； II，110=Pug．52； A．III，20； J．III，431 （opp．sāra）； Miln．267，413 （tacchako phegguṁ apaharitvā sāraṁ ādiyati）．（Page 480）

（၁） ထအောင်း၊ ခအောင်း။ （၂） အကာ။

V: Pheggū：A Therī of Jambudīpa who came to Ceylon，where she taught the Vinaya．Dpv．xviii．12．
DOP: pheggu m.f. and mfn. [ cf S. phalgu], 1. ( m.f. ) ( i ) sapwood, the (weak and worthless) wood surrounding the pith or heartwood of a tree; M I 192, 18 (atikamm’ eva sāraṃ atikamma ~uṃ atikamma tacaṃ …); 488, 29 (mahā sālarukkho, tassa … ~u palujjeyya … apagataphegguko suddho assa sāre patiṭṭhito); S III 141, 30 (~uṃ pi nādhigaccheyya kuto sāraṃ); A III 44, 8 (mahāsālā … ~unā vaḍḍhanti sārena vaḍḍhanti); Ja III 431, 13 (ghuṇapāṇako … ~uṃ khāditvā tasmiṃ khīṇe sāraṃ khādituṃ nāsakkhi); 431, 18* (sabbā parikkhatā ~u yāva tassā gatī ahu; 431, 20´ : yāva tassā ~uyā nipphatti ahosi sā sabbā khāditā); Mil 413, 16 (tacchako ~uṃ apaharitvā sāraṃ ādiyati); Vism 612, 25 (~u viya sukhabhañjanīyatāya); — ( ii ) property of little value; Ud-a 104, 2 (satta lohāni kahāpaṇo ca sāro nāma, sayanacchādanapāvuraṇarattacelādīni ~u nāma); — 2. ( f. ) a tree; SAF: the Redwood fig tree, Ficus oppositifolia Roxb.; Abh 572 (kākodumbarikā ~u); — 3. ( mfn. ), pithless; worthless; Abh 698 (asāraṃ ca ~u ca); A II 109, 35 foll. (cattāro ’me bhikkhave rukkhā … ~u °-parivāro ~u sāraparivāro … cattāro ’me rukkhūpamā puggalā … kathaṃ ca bhikkhave puggalo ~u hoti °-parivāro …; Mp III 119, 27 foll.: nissāro °-rukkho °-rukkheh’ eva parivuto); Pp-a 229, 12 (puggalesu pana sīlasāravirahato °-tā … veditabbā); — °- ppatta , mfn. , reached to the sapwood; D III 51, 16 (na … tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca, api ca kho ~ā hotī ti; Sv 840, 20 : tacato abbhantaraṃ phegguṃ pattā, °-sadisā hotī ti attho); — see also apagataphegguka ( sv apagacchati ), aphegguka.

pheṇa.p: [Phi+yu] (na) Google Translate Phi Unna Teti Dhatu Taw Yu Pissaya. Phiyati Uggissati Unnamati Phen. သူ စိ. 372.] Foam. Foam
a: ဖိ ဥန္နတေတိ ဓာတုတော ယုပစ္စယော။ ဖိယတိ ဥဂ္ဂစ္ဆတိ ဥန္နမတီတိ ဖေဏံ။ သူစိ။ ၃၇၂။] အမြှုပ်၊ ရေမြှုပ်။

B:
pheṇa： pheṇa（na）
ဖေဏ（န）
[phi+yu．phi unnateti dhātuto yupaccayo．phiyati uggacchati unnamatīti pheṇaṃ．sūci．372．]
[ဖိ+ယု။ ဖိ ဥန္နတေတိ ဓာတုတော ယုပစ္စယော။ ဖိယတိ ဥဂ္ဂစ္ဆတိ ဥန္နမတီတိ ဖေဏံ။ သူစိ။ ၃၇၂။]
P: Pheṇa，[cp．Vedic phena，with *ph fr．sp°，connected with Lat．spūma，scum，Ags．fām=Ger．feim=E．foam] scum，foam，froth，only in cpds．viz．： --uddehakaṁ （adv．） （paccamāna，boiling） with scum on top，throwing up foam M．III，167； A．I，141； Nd2 304III C； J．III，46； Miln．357．--paṭala a film of scum Vism．359； VbhA．65．--piṇḍa a lump or heap of foam S．III，140 sq．=Vism．479 （in simile of rūpa）； Nd2 680 AII； Vism．40 （in comp）； VbhA．32 sq．bubbuḷaka a bubble of scum Vism．171，259，345； VbhA．242．--mālā a wreath or garland of scum Miln．117．--mālin with a wreath of scum Miln．260．--missa mixed with froth Vism．263．--vaṇṇa colour of scum Vism．263．（Page 480）

DOP: pheṇa m. [ S. pheṇa, phena], scum, foam, froth; Sp 851, 31 (bhikkhu … bhājanaṃ āmasati pidhānaṃ āmasati uggataṃ ~aṃ chinditvā harati); Ps IV 40, 24 (upari ~o uggacchati); Spk I 300, 19 (mātā macchamaṃsādīni khādati sabbāni pi ekarattivāsena paccitvā ~aṃ viya vilīyanti); Pj II 249, 7 (bhatte paccamāne taṇḍulamalaṃ ca udakamalaṃ ca ~ena saddhiṃ uṭṭhahitvā …); — °’- uddehakaṃ , ind. , heaping up scum; so as to produce foam; M III 167, 9 (tam enaṃ … nirayapālā … tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti … so tattha ~aṃ paccati) ≠ A IV 133, 26 (Mp IV 65, 12 : pheṇaṃ uddehitvā ussādetvā ti attho, Be so; Se uddahitvā; Ce uddahitvā uppādetī ti; Ee uddihitvā uppādetī ti); Ja III 46, 21 (khāralohodake ~aṃ paccamānā); Mil 357, 17 (avīcimahāniraye … ~aṃ samparivattakaṃ paccati); Vism 260, 5 (pānabhojanādikaṃ udaragginā ~aṃ pakkaṃ); — ° ûpama , mfn. , like foam; Dhp 46 (~aṃ kāyam imaṃ viditvā); — °- piṇḍa , m. , a mass, a ball, of foam; S III 140, 26 (nadī mahantaṃ ~aṃ āvaheyya); Vism 40, 4 (gaṇḍo ~o viya vilīyitvā antaradhāyi); Spk II 321, 5 foll. (~amhi sāro nāma kiṃ bhaveyya); — °- mālā , f. , a circle of foam; Mil 117, 26 ; — °- māli(n) , mfn. , with a circle of foam; Mil 260, 17 .
